summary: Max Verstappen won the São Paulo Grand Prix from P17 on the grid, 19.5s ahead of Esteban Ocon, with Pierre Gasly completing the podium.
Max Verstappen made the biggest climb, from P17 to P1.
Fernando Alonso had a day to forget, dropping from P9 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 1 red flag, 2 safety cars and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised BEA (10 second time penalty) and PIA (10 second time penalty).
There were 35 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 62 points over Lando Norris.
